name: Emerald
overview: The emerald is a precious stone prominently featured in Scripture, symbolizing beauty and divine craftsmanship. It is set in the high priest's breastplate alongside other gems (Exodus 28:18) and is noted as valuable merchandise in Tyre's trade (Ezekiel 27:16). The stone also appears symbolically in the foundation of the holy city, representing stability and glory (Revelation 21:19), and is associated with the radiant colors of the rainbow surrounding God's throne (Revelation 4:3). These references collectively highlight the emerald's significance as a symbol of God's holiness, splendor, and the perfection of His eternal kingdom.
